services.name: Pasta Classes
services.desc: Grab a few friends and learn to make some pasta in our pasta window right at the heart of our restaurant. During these highly intimate hands-on class in our pasta-making window, we teach a small group of 4-6 people the art of handmade pasta -- from creating your own volcano of dough, to shaping 4 different forms. You'll learn about the origins and various techniques, and go home with a box full of your hard work. Following the hands-on portion of the evening, you'll enjoy a generous family-style meal from our Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded team, giving participants the opportunity to experience the spirit of true Italian hospitality at the best seats in the house, our pasta counter. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Benvenuto! Welcome to the private event space from the team at Tortello. “DESORA” means “upstairs/overhead" in Venetian dialect, where Dario grew up. Guests can expect the same commitment to high quality ingredients, chef-driven authentic Italian food, craziness for pasta, and Italian hospitality as Tortello, only in a private, intimate space right upstairs. From family style dinners to pasta classes, DESORA is here to help you celebrate life's occasions, bond with your team, or entertain your clients.
